Shorts Editor Online 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export vertical short-form videos with simple instructions—no editing experience required.
- Upload raw clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB), describe your desired result, and download a polished 1080p MP4.
- Automatic text overlays, beat-synced cuts, and support for common short-form platforms (TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Reels).
- Integrated free token system—no registration needed for 100 free credits.
- Seamless session handling, error recovery, and real-time progress feedback.
- Clear prompts for upload, export, credit check, and timeline/status review.
